obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: may be used for a maximum of 20 impacts before re-certification
obligations.exception: this limit does not apply to propulsion or guidance components
obligations.ears: The certified upper legform impactor may be used for a maximum of 20 impacts before re-certification.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.ears: When more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification or any impactor transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC, the impactor shall also be re-certified.

derived.text: When more than one year has elapsed since the previous certification, the impactor shall be re-certified.
When any impactor transducer output, in any impact, has exceeded the specified CAC, the impactor shall be re-certified.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be stored for a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 ± 10 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C prior to impactor removal for certification
obligations.ears: The foam flesh for the test impactor shall be stored for a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 ± 10 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C prior to impactor removal for certification.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall have a temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C at the time of impact
obligations.ears: The test impactor itself shall have a temperature of 20 °C ± 2 °C at the time of impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall apply at a relative humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent after a soak period of at least four hours prior to their application in a test
obligations.ears: The temperature tolerances for the test impactor shall apply at a relative humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent after a soak period of at least four hours prior to their application in a test.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall have a stabilized humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C during certification
obligations.ears: The test facility used for the certification test shall have a stabilized humidity of 40 ± 30 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C during certification.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be calibrated is removed from the controlled storage area
obligations.ears: Each certification shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be calibrated is removed from the controlled storage area.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall be measured at the time of certification, and recorded in the certification report
obligations.ears: The relative humidity and temperature of the certification area shall be measured at the time of certification, and recorded in the certification report.

derived.text: The relative humidity and temperature of the certification area shall be measured at the time of certification.
The relative humidity and temperature of the certification area shall be recorded in the certification report.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the peak force measured in each load transducer shall be not less than 1.20 kN and not more than 1.55 kN and the difference between the peak forces measured in the top and bottom load transducers shall not be more than 0.10 kN
obligations.ears: When the impactor is propelled into a stationary cylindrical pendulum, the peak force measured in each load transducer shall be not less than 1.20 kN and not more than 1.55 kN and the difference between the peak forces measured in the top and bottom load transducers shall not be more than 0.10 kN.

obligations.subject: n1

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: The difference between the upper and lower peak bending moments shall not be more than 20 Nm
obligations.ears: When the impactor is propelled into a stationary cylindrical pendulum, the difference between the upper and lower peak bending moments shall not be more than 20 Nm.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the readings used shall be from the initial impact with the pendulum and not from the arresting phase
obligations.ears: For all these values, the readings used shall be from the initial impact with the pendulum and not from the arresting phase.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be so arranged that the arresting phase does not overlap in time with the initial impact
obligations.ears: Any system used to arrest the impactor or pendulum shall be so arranged that the arresting phase does not overlap in time with the initial impact.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall not cause the transducer outputs to exceed the specified CAC
obligations.ears: The arresting system shall not cause the transducer outputs to exceed the specified CAC.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: The instrumentation response value CFC, as defined in ISO 6487:2002, shall be 180 for all transducers
